 Invesco QQQ (NASDAQ:QQQ) Stock Jumps 1.2% - Here's Why
 Written by MarketBeat October 19, 2026 Add As Preferred Source Share Share Share This Article Link copied to clipboard. Close 
 Image from MarketBeat Media, LLC. 
 Key Points
 Invesco QQQ rose 1.2% to $718.36 in Monday trading, although volume was about 23% below its average. The ETF remains focused on Nasdaq-100 mega-cap technology and growth stocks.
 QQQ’s addition of NVIDIA and Apple increases its exposure to influential technology companies and reinforces its concentration in artificial intelligence and mega-cap growth.
 The fund reportedly attracted approximately $1.66 billion , signaling strong investor demand, while its quarterly dividend fell to $0.7514 from $0.8135, representing an annualized yield of about 0.4%.

 Get Invesco QQQ alerts: Sign Up Shares of Invesco QQQ ( NASDAQ:QQQ - Get Free Report ) shot up 1.2% on Monday. The company traded as high as $724.55 and last traded at $718.36. Approximately 36,713,965 shares traded hands during trading, a decline of 23% from the average daily volume of 47,965,766 shares. The stock had previously closed at $709.80. Key Invesco QQQ News
 Failed Breakout in Tech? 3 Sectors Leading the Market Rotation 
 Here are the key news stories impacting Invesco QQQ this week: 
 Positive Sentiment: QQQ’s addition of NVIDIA and Apple increases exposure to two of the market’s most influential technology companies and reinforces the fund’s concentration in artificial intelligence and mega-cap growth. Invesco QQQ Adds NVIDIA and Apple 
 Positive Sentiment: Growth ETFs remain in focus as easing AI-related price pressures could improve the outlook for technology companies, while funds with more reasonable valuations and positive momentum may attract additional assets. Growth ETFs in Focus 
 Positive Sentiment: QQQ reportedly attracted approximately $1.66 billion , signaling strong demand for Nasdaq-100 exposure. The article also highlights a lower-cost, nearly identical Invesco fund, which could pressure QQQ’s fee competitiveness but confirms ongoing interest in the strategy. QQQ Pulled In $1.66 Billion 
 Invesco QQQ Stock Up 1.2%
 The business's 50 day moving average is $726.69 and its 200-day moving average is $704.34. Invesco QQQ Cuts Dividend
 The Nasdaq Nears a Major Breakout: 5 Tech ETFs to Play the Move 
 The company also recently disclosed a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, October 8th. Shareholders of record on Monday, September 21st were given a $0.7514 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Monday, September 21st. This represents a $3.01 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 0.4%. This is a drop from Invesco QQQ's previous quarterly dividend of $0.8135. Institutional Investors Weigh In On Invesco QQQ
 Hedge funds and other institutional investors have recently modified their holdings of the company. Corient Private Wealth LLC grew its position in Invesco QQQ by 3,567.7% in the 4th quarter. Corient Private Wealth LLC now owns 21,436,917 shares of the exchange traded fund's stock worth $13,168,912,000 after purchasing an additional 20,852,432 shares during the last quarter. GoalVest Advisory LLC increased its stake in shares of Invesco QQQ by 20,256.6% in the third quarter. GoalVest Advisory LLC now owns 613,955 shares of the exchange traded fund's stock valued at $454,185,000 after purchasing an additional 610,939 shares during the period. Corient Private Wealth LP raised its holdings in shares of Invesco QQQ by 506.8% during the second quarter. Corient Private Wealth LP now owns 545,270 shares of the exchange traded fund's stock valued at $401,553,000 after buying an additional 455,412 shares during the last quarter. Hsbc Holdings PLC raised its holdings in shares of Invesco QQQ by 337.6% during the fourth quarter. Hsbc Holdings PLC now owns 273,787 shares of the exchange traded fund's stock valued at $168,945,000 after buying an additional 389,028 shares during the last quarter. Finally, Alaska Permanent Fund Corp bought a new stake in shares of Invesco QQQ during the second quarter valued at approximately $207,072,000. 44.58% of the stock is currently owned by institutional investors and hedge funds. About Invesco QQQ
 ( Get Free Report ) SpaceX Defies Gravity With a Nasdaq-100 Double-Weighting Boost 
 PowerShares QQQ Trust, Series 1 is a unit investment trust that issues securities called Nasdaq-100 Index Tracking Stock. The Trust's investment objective is to provide investment results that generally correspond to the price and yield performance of the Nasdaq-100 Index. The Trust provides investors with the opportunity to purchase units of beneficial interest in the Trust representing proportionate undivided interests in the portfolio of securities held by the Trust, which consists of substantially all of the securities, in substantially the same weighting, as the component securities of the Nasdaq-100 Index.
